title: Knowledge Graph declaration
description: A Declaration. Any field not listed here is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

name.description: The Knowledge Graph's name. The declaration file is `<name>.json`.

iriBase.description: The address its IRIs are minted under, before the version. An identifier a program reads is `<iriBase><version>/…`; a page meant for a person is `<iriBase>v<major>/…`.

id.description: The Subgraph's name, unique within its Knowledge Graph.

path.description: The directory, relative to the declaration.

anyOf.description: A Subgraph of Skills: the instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.
A Subgraph of Node Schemas: files that state the shape other files must have.
A Subgraph of Roles: the responsibilities an Actor takes on, and who takes them on.
A Subgraph of Processes: BPMN diagrams that coordinate Tasks, and the decision tables their gateways compute from.
A Subgraph describing the language models an Actor may be: which languages each is good at, and whether a person checked.

A Graph Kind a Harness defines. To a reader that knows only bootstrap it is an Extension: A field of a Declaration, or of one of its entries, that is not defined here. A reader that does not recognise the field ignores it, and the rest of the Declaration keeps its meaning.

items.description: A named set of Node Kinds.

title.description: A short name for people, shown as its README's heading.

description.description: What it holds, in a sentence or two, shown under that heading.

items.description: A directory entry of a Declaration: an id, a directory, and the Graph Kinds its Node Instances' kinds belong to.

needs.description: Its Dependencies: the Knowledge Graphs it may refer into.

items.description: A Declaration's `needs` entry naming another Knowledge Graph. References may point from this graph's Node Instances into the named one, never back.

nodeSchemas.description: Its Node Kinds: each `$schema` value its Node Instances may carry, paired with the Node Schema that defines it — an IRI, or a path relative to this Declaration.

src.description: The file, relative to the declaration.

role.description: The part the file plays, such as `instance-readme`.

items.description: A file entry of a Declaration: one file about the repository itself, whose `role` field says what it is for.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One file, or one part of a file addressable by an IRI fragment, named by an IRI.

Reference.title: Reference
Reference.description: A Node's naming of another Node by its IRI.

NodeSchema.title: NodeSchema
NodeSchema.description: A schema a Node can be checked against: a JSON Schema, or a published external schema such as BPMN's.

NodeKind.title: NodeKind
NodeKind.description: A name paired with a Node Schema.

Subkind.title: Subkind
Subkind.description: A Node Kind whose Node Schema requires everything another Node Kind's does, so every Node that satisfies it satisfies the other too.

NodeInstance.title: NodeInstance
NodeInstance.description: A Node that names its Node Kind, in `$schema` or front matter, and satisfies that kind's Node Schema.

Declaration.title: Declaration
Declaration.description: A JSON document, `<name>.json`, that gives a name and lists directory entries and file entries.

Extension.title: Extension

src.description: The file, relative to the declaration.

role.description: The part the file plays, such as `instance-readme`.

Asset.description: A file entry of a Declaration: one file about the repository itself, whose `role` field says what it is for.

KnowledgeGraph.title: KnowledgeGraph
KnowledgeGraph.description: The Node Schemas, Node Instances and Assets one Declaration lists, as of one version of the repository. Published as JSON-LD, the statements of each Subgraph's Node Instances form one named graph.

Dependency.title: Dependency
Dependency.description: A Declaration's `needs` entry naming another Knowledge Graph. References may point from this graph's Node Instances into the named one, never back.

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Node Instances that describe the subject matter of a Knowledge Graph, such as records, documents, catalogues and their terms, rather than how to work with it.

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A unit of work, stated by what it needs to begin and what it produces.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: A person, an agent or a program that can carry out Tasks.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A Node Instance holding natural-language instructions an Actor follows to carry out a Task.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: A Node Instance naming a part an Actor takes on to carry out Tasks, and listing the Skills that part needs.

ProcessNode.title: ProcessNode
ProcessNode.description: A BPMN flow node: an activity (a task or call activity), a gateway, or an event.

SequenceFlow.title: SequenceFlow
SequenceFlow.description: A directed connection in a BPMN process from one Process Node to the next.

Process.title: Process
Process.description: A Node Instance holding a BPMN process that coordinates Tasks: its Process Nodes, joined by Sequence Flows, sit in lanes that each name a Role.

Harness.title: Harness
Harness.description: A Knowledge Graph whose Subgraphs hold Skills, Roles or Processes: what an Actor uses to work with a Knowledge Graph, including itself.
